meta.subject: Social Science
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Standard Six Social Science Term I 2025 English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.extraction_policy: Maximum useful competitive-exam coverage. Includes prejudice/stereotype/discrimination concepts, constitutional Articles 14, 15(1) and 17, caste/gender/religious/socio-economic inequality, 2011 Census district data, remedial measures, notable achievers, glossary, evaluation and reasoning. Excludes classroom anecdote names, activity mechanics and generic project/life-skill prompts.
source_notes: This file is stored as term-1/unit-8.json; display_unit=2 keeps the learner-facing Civics unit number correct.
English and Tamil printed pagination differs by one page in this unit. Questions therefore preserve separate English and Tamil page references.
2011 literacy and sex-ratio data are explicitly presented as dated Census figures, not as current district rankings.
Biographical facts are included only where they are competitive-exam relevant (constitutional role, major awards, national/international achievements, offices, years and institutions).
The soft-ball classroom stereotype story, generic group-discussion/project instructions and village life-skill prompt are excluded as low-value exam material.
All constitutional wording follows the textbook. No external legal elaboration has been silently added.
